label: rem:levi-form-defect-remark
title: Matter as the failure of the Frobenius structure
html: The matter locus defines matter as the failure of the Frobenius structure. The Levi form \mathcal{L}_p measures the non-degeneracy of the contact structure at p. When \mathcal{L}_p \neq 0, the Frobenius form \lambda cannot extend smoothly through p, creating a topological defect.
heading: Remark
